name: bdsmartmall-platform
description: BDSMARTMALL v5: 100% working client+server fallback for every feature (products add/edit/delete, cart & multi-item/single-item open-box COD orders, orders list & status update, expense ledger, live fraud checker, CSV bulk import, dropshipping sync, drag-and-drop & custom HTML/CSS/JS layout persistence, shoppable reels add/play, 13-group BD categories).

scripts.db:init: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute bd-smartmall --local --file=./schema.sql
scripts.db:init:remote: cd worker && npx wrangler d1 execute bd-smartmall --remote --file=./schema.sql
